name: Rollganic Live Resin | The Spice!
description:
Unleash the power of Rollganic The Spice! Live Resin, a truly unique concentrate crafted for the discerning connoisseur who craves intensity.

This light beige live resin, with no color remediation treatment, maintains the raw, unadulterated essence of the strain, offering an authentic experience that cannabis enthusiasts love.

The result is a clean, flavorful extract that packs a punch in both taste and effects. The The Spice! is a gassy, potent strain with a flavor profile that’s tailor-made for gas lovers.

Expect a bold, pungent aroma with distinct notes of licorice, anise, pepper, and cloves that linger and intensify with every dab.
